description: This file defines a Credentials model and utilities for loading, managing, and displaying credentials within a software project. It includes classes for handling credentials, loading from extensions, providers, environment variables, and user settings, as well as custom serialization and error handling.

classes.name: LoadingError
classes.description: Custom exception class for errors encountered during extension loading.

classes.name: CredentialsLoader
classes.description: Class responsible for creating and managing credential models, loading credentials from extensions, providers, environment variables, and user settings.

classes.name: Credentials
classes.description: A model class for storing and displaying provider credentials, extending the dynamically created credentials model.

methods.name: format_credentials
methods.description: Prepares a dictionary of credentials with proper formatting and descriptions for model creation.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Main method to load and compile all credentials from various sources into a model.

methods.name: __repr__
methods.description: String representation of the Credentials object.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates current credentials with incoming credentials.
